The agent-run harness contract's run verb takes a fourth fixed selection word, session, beside stand, all and a blitz-tests file name.
run session runs the escher-session boot-path flows: cargo test -p seven_guis --locked --test cli_flow, so the packages run reaches move from blitz-tests alone to blitz-tests or seven_guis (seven_guis under session alone).
session is a closed word matched before the file-name arm; an extra argument exits 2, a run before boot exits 3, a failing flow exits 1 with no captured output in stdout or events.jsonl, and an empty session run (0 tests) ends with outcome failed, never a pass.
No new verb, event, event field, state file, env read, listener or process: run session emits the existing run.start, test and run.end events, and status reads the session run; boot is unchanged and still builds blitz-tests alone.
The agent-run contract tests grew from 14 to 20 cases (six session cases) and the ci-scripts leg's unittest count from 112 to 118; the live run session became the first smoke a plan can name as a role=smoke entry (L1's boot-path smoke).

contract/agent-run-events/test and contract/agent-run-test-event/file: under session a test event's file is the seven_guis cli_flow target, not a blitz-tests file; any row saying the file is always a blitz-tests test file is stale.

decision/agent-run-no-captured-output: holds for the session flows too, now pinned by a contract case that a failing session flow carries no captured output into stdout or events.jsonl; its guard cell (the agent-run contract tests) gains that case.

decision/agent-run-raw-output-never-printed and decision/agent-run-log-no-user-content: their reach now spans the cargo output of the seven_guis cli_flow run, which drives escher-session; the rule is unchanged.
decision/agent-run-raw-log-unscrubbed: the raw log now also holds the seven_guis cli_flow cargo output when the selection is session.

decision/agent-run-cleanup-scoped and decision/session-state-dir-private: the session flows' own state dirs are the cli_flow target's cf-* dirs under CARGO_TARGET_TMPDIR, as before; agent-run adds no state file of its own for them — check that no row says agent-run state covers only blitz-tests runs.

body_fields.name: agent-run session selection reaches seven_guis fixed
body_fields.rule: The agent-run `session` selection alone reaches the seven_guis package, by the one fixed call `cargo test -p seven_guis --locked --test cli_flow`; every other selection reaches blitz-tests alone.
body_fields.because: The run verb now reaches a second package under one closed word, a widening of what the selection reaches that no standing row states.

body_fields.name: Empty agent-run session run never a pass
body_fields.rule: An agent-run session run that ran no test exits 1 with outcome failed and is never reported as a pass.
body_fields.because: The chunk pins that an empty session run reports failed with exit 1, a rule on the run's reported outcome that no standing row holds.

body_fields.promise: session runs cargo test -p seven_guis --locked --test cli_flow; a closed word matched before the file-name arm, so a blitz-tests file named session does not divert it, the argument count checked first (exit 2) and the boot next (exit 3).
body_fields.because: The run verb takes a fourth selection word, session, beside stand, all and a file name, and no selection row states it.

body_fields.name: Session boot-path smoke run through agent-run
body_fields.rule: The escher-session boot-path smoke is run as agent-run run session and is nameable as a plan's role=smoke entry, no longer driven by hand.
body_fields.because: The session binary's boot-path smoke is now reachable through the agent-run contract, and no row of the session lifecycle states how the smoke is run.

body_fields.value: run {selection} runs cargo test --locked, -p blitz-tests under stand, all and a file name and -p seven_guis --test cli_flow under session, merged output to run.log truncated at its start, sets status.json's run state running then passed or failed, and parses libtest's pretty lines into events.
body_fields.because: The run verb now reaches two packages, seven_guis under the session selection alone, so a promise of cargo test -p blitz-tests for every run is false.

body_fields.value: stand_session_lifecycle, stand_session_quiet and the session selection's cli_flow flows start and stop a session host process and its socket, a surface of the session library, not of this contract
body_fields.because: The session selection runs seven_guis' cli_flow flows, whose own session hosts the script neither starts nor holds, so the exception must name them beside the two stand checks.

body_fields.value: Nothing is seeded for the agent-run contract: the fixtures are code compiled into their targets, by boot for the blitz-tests targets and by the run's own cargo call for the session selection's seven_guis target.
body_fields.because: boot still builds blitz-tests alone while run session's cargo call builds seven_guis, so fixtures compiled into each target by boot is no longer true of every target.

body:
The session gave the agent-run contract's run verb a fourth selection word, session, beside stand, all and a blitz-tests file name.
session is a closed word matched before the file-stem arm; it fixes the run's one cargo call to cargo test -p seven_guis --locked --test cli_flow, the boot-path smoke of the escher-session binary.
The cargo call now takes its package from a variable set to blitz-tests by every other arm, so stand, all and a file stem call what they called; the run verb now reaches two packages, blitz-tests or seven_guis.
No new verb, event, event field, state file, environment read, listener or process of the script's own: run session emits the existing run.start, test and run.end events, and a failing or empty session run carries no captured output and is never a pass.
The contract tests grew from 14 to 20 cases and the ci-scripts leg's unittest count from 112 to 118; escher-session itself, the session socket and the MCP server are unchanged.

body_fields.what: the agent-run contract script — the harness CLI whose run verb takes a selection and reaches cargo test, its usage line, its exit codes and its run.start, test and run.end events
the agent-run contract tests run by the ci-scripts leg — the cases that pin agent-run's selections, exit codes, events and that no captured output is printed

body: decision/agent-run-selection-allowlist goes stale: the selection no longer reaches cargo only as a test stem; the closed word session reaches it as the fixed package seven_guis and fixed target cli_flow, matched before the file-stem arm, and no caller text reaches the cargo call.
contract/agent-run-cli/2 goes stale where it lists the selections: session joins stand, all and a blitz-tests file name; run session with an extra argument exits 2, the argument count checked first.
decision/agent-run-events-metadata-only gains run session as a run under it: the same run.start, test and run.end events with selection session, no new field, still harness metadata only.
decision/agent-run-raw-log-unprinted now also covers the session flows: a failing session flow's captured output reaches neither stdout nor the events log, pinned by a new contract case.
decision/locked-builds reaches a second cargo call of the harness: the session selection's call to seven_guis carries --locked like the blitz-tests calls.

Indirect: rows that the harness holds no listener or process of its own, and decision/session-socket-sole-listener with absence/served-network-api, now meet a harness selection whose flows start escher-session hosts on their Unix sockets under the cli_flow target's own temporary state dirs; the script itself adds no listener or process.

Indirect: the session state directory rows (decision/state-dir-owner-only, decision/state-dir-path-is-parameter, decision/state-dir-deletes-only-own) now rule over state dirs a harness selection reaches through the cli_flow flows, created under CARGO_TARGET_TMPDIR as before.
Indirect: rows that the harness reads no secret or new environment hold unchanged under run session; no environment read was added to agent-run.

body_fields.fact: agent-run's run selections are a closed set of words — stand, all, session — each matched before the file-stem arm, so a test file named after a word never diverts it; session alone reaches the package seven_guis, by the fixed call cargo test -p seven_guis --locked --test cli_flow.
an agent-run session run that ran no test exits 1 with outcome failed and is never reported as a pass.

body: The escher-session binary's own surfaces — its flags, roles, exit codes, stdout and stderr lines, and coverage line — are unchanged; the smoke only drives them.
The driver session socket's grammar, bounds, replies, idle expiry and refusal causes, and the MCP server's transport, request bounds, results and protocol errors are unchanged.
Engine and page input validation — select lists, accessibility, aria, range, password masking, CSS, HTML parsing, stable ids, snapshot text — is not reached.
Dependency security — the audit tool, licence gate, pins, git dependencies and workspace versions — is not reached: no dependency changed.
Cold-agent runs, recorded and kept checks, the coverage floor checker and apt-install are not reached.
CI tokens, secrets, signing material, publish guards and the WPT workflows are not reached.
Outbound HTTP, script fetchers, navigation schemes, cookies, cache and history storage are not reached.

body_fields.why: A history of how the smoke used to be reached («no longer driven by hand»), resting on a list of moved counts, whose live part is the session selection's contract row and the plan's own role entry, which the route holds.

body:
The agent-run contract's run verb gained a fourth selection word, session, beside stand, all and a blitz-tests file name.
run session runs cargo test -p seven_guis --locked --test cli_flow: the seven_guis shell flows that drive the escher-session binary; every other selection still runs cargo test -p blitz-tests --locked as before.
session is a fixed word matched before the file-name arm; the argument count is checked first (an extra argument exits 2), and before boot it exits 3 with no cargo call.
No new verb, event, event field, state file or process: run session emits the existing run.start, test and run.end events with selection session; boot still builds blitz-tests alone; the Windows entry stays a pass-through.
Six contract cases were added under the cargo shim (session runs the flow target, before-boot exit 3, extra-argument exit 2, fixed word before a file of that name, failing flow carries no captured output, empty session run is never a pass).
The L1 boot-path smoke of escher-session, once driven by hand, is now reachable as agent-run run session and nameable as a plan's smoke entry.

body_fields.what: the agent-run contract: the five-command harness entry (boot, run, status, logs, cleanup) whose run verb takes a selection and drives cargo test, with its usage line and run selections
the agent-run contract tests: the Python unittest cases that pin agent-run's verbs, selections, exit codes, events and status under a cargo shim

body: contract/agent-run-verbs/run: its run {selection} runs cargo test -p blitz-tests --locked is now stale; the session selection runs cargo test -p seven_guis --locked --test cli_flow, so run reaches blitz-tests or seven_guis.
The agent-run selection rows (agent-run run selection stand, all, {name}; agent-run selections run stand, run all, run {file}): still true, but a session selection row now belongs beside them.
contract/agent-run-selection/name and contract/agent-run-selections/file: a file stem named session no longer selects that file; session is a fixed word matched before the file-name arm.
contract/agent-run/invocation: the selections it names now include session (stand, all, session or a blitz-tests file name).
decision/agent-run-holds-no-process: its exception gains the session flows' hosts, started and stopped by the cli_flow target's own checks, not by agent-run.
The session-lifecycle overview: its line that the session is not part of the five-command agent-run contract is stale, since agent-run run session now drives the session binary's flows.
contract/agent-run-exit-codes/2 and /3: run session with an extra argument exits 2 before any call past boot's; run session before boot exits 3 with no cargo call.

decision/empty-run-is-never-a-pass and contract/agent-run-exit-codes/1: an empty session run (cli_flow running 0 tests, the off-unix shape) exits 1 with outcome failed; a failing session flow exits 1.

decision/test-output-never-reaches-events and decision/agent-run-events-content-free: now pinned for the session selection too; a failing session flow's captured output reaches neither stdout nor the events file.
contract/agent-run-events/run-start, /test, /run-end and /status: unchanged in shape, they now carry the selection value session, and status reads the session run.
contract/agent-run-verbs/boot: unchanged, still builds blitz-tests alone; run session's own cargo call builds seven_guis.
contract/agent-run-state/files: unchanged; the session flows' state directories are the cli_flow target's own under the cargo target tmp dir, not agent-run state.
contract/agent-run/windows-entry: the Windows entry is an unchanged pass-through and carries the session word through.
decision/one-agent-run-driver-at-a-time: now governs a session run as well as blitz-tests runs.
decision/shell-flows-under-cargo-test and decision/shell-flows-are-cargo-test-assets: the seven_guis shell flows are now also reached through the agent-run contract's session selection.
decision/seven-guis-cli-targets-unix-only and decision/cli-and-flow-targets-unix-gated: off unix the cli_flow target runs no test, which run session reads as a failed empty run.
decision/ui-driven-through-session-binary: the binary's boot-path smoke is now an agent-run selection a plan names as its smoke entry.
decision/cargo-legs-locked: run session's cargo call is locked like the other selections.

decision/python-script-tests-under-unittest, decision/ci-scripts-unit-tested and decision/mutation-controlled-tests: six new agent-run contract cases, recorded red against the old script before green; no row holds the case count.

body_fields.fact: agent-run run session runs cargo test -p seven_guis --locked --test cli_flow; session is a closed word matched before the file-name arm, the argument count checked first (exit 2) and the boot checked next (exit 3).
the agent-run run verb reaches two packages: blitz-tests for stand, all and a file name, seven_guis for the session selection alone.
the escher-session boot-path smoke (L1) is reachable as agent-run run session and is nameable as a plan's role=smoke entry, no longer driven by hand.

body: The escher-session binary itself: its command line, exit status, error object, stderr, recording and state directory rows; the binary was not changed, only reached.
Driver session, session host, session wire and session errors contracts; no protocol, bound or verb moved.
Harness construction, core, input, inspection, settle, screenshot and contrast contracts, and the seven_guis headless stand rows.
The cold-agent pipe rows: its verbs, events, exit codes, verdict and invocation; that pipe is a separate entry and was not changed.
MCP server and MCP role rows, refusal causes, lint defects and snapshot rows.
CI integration rows: legs, triggers, caches, artifacts, package installs and the leg script exit codes; no leg, job or trigger changed and no row holds the ci-scripts test count.
Coverage floors, mutation, complexity and stand-repeat quality gates; no threshold or budget moved.
WPT runner, status set and conformance rows, and test data, fixtures and mocking discipline rows.
